mapper.insert: INSERT INTO permission (name, code, url, type, parent_id, sort, icon, status, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{url}, #{type}, #{parentId}, #{sort}, #{icon}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM permission p INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.sort ASC
